label: File storage
description: Optional: connect your own S3-compatible bucket to upload files from the dashboard. Files stay private in your bucket, and every download uses a link that expires after 5 minutes. 1. Create a bucket. Cloudflare R2 is the cheapest option because it charges nothing for downloads; Amazon S3, Backblaze B2 and Wasabi also work. 2. Create an access key limited to that bucket and folder, allowing PutObject, GetObject, AbortMultipartUpload and ListMultipartUploadParts. 3. Fill in the fields below, save, then choose Actions → Test connection.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the access key by writing and reading a small test file in the folder.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: The S3 API endpoint. Leave empty for Amazon S3.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: For example us-east-1. Use auto for Cloudflare R2.

fields.label: Folder
fields.description: Uploads go into this folder of the bucket. Limit your access key to it.

fields.label: Secret access key
fields.description: Stored as plain text in your store's settings, so use a key that can only reach this bucket folder.
